decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 10 June 2005, that the roof extension, comprising a rear dormer with a 3.8m projection, a height of 2.8m and a width of 6.4m, and a hip to gable alteration measuring a perpendicular depth of 4.0m, a height of 3.2m with a width of 8.1m, are lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the total volume of the proposed development does not exceed 50m3 on the roof, or 70m3 of the original dwellinghouse.

Condition : 2 - If you commence work on the ground floor extension under planning application ref: 01010/47/P2 before you have completed the loft extension you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the loft extension.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension to house.
